name: context-handoff-cli
description: For the terminal: past a context threshold, records a hand-off, then starts a fresh session in the same terminal with /clear and continues the work from the notes

enabled.title: Automatic hand-off
enabled.description: Hand off on its own once the context window passes the threshold. Off, /handoff-now still works. /handoff-off and /handoff-on override it for one session.

threshold.title: Threshold (%)
threshold.description: How full the context window is, in percent, before the hand-off starts. Checked after each turn.

retriggerStep.title: Retry step (%)
retriggerStep.description: After an interrupted or failed hand-off, try again once the context has grown this many points.

fallback.title: When /clear does not start a fresh session
fallback.description: compact: compact the conversation down to the notes in place and continue from them. none: give the hand-off up and say so.

closeCommand.title: Project close skill
closeCommand.description: A slash command or skill of the project that records the hand-off, run when the project has it. Otherwise a built-in prompt records PROGRESS.md or HANDOFF.md.

closePrompt.title: Hand-off prompt
closePrompt.description: Replaces the built-in hand-off prompt and the close skill. {percent} and {threshold} are filled in.

resumePrompt.title: Resume prompt
resumePrompt.description: Replaces the built-in prompt submitted in the fresh session.

endPhrases.title: Phrases that end the session
endPhrases.description: Comma-separated. A message of yours holding every word of one of them, in any order and ignoring case, starts no hand-off when its turn ends: the session is ending. An English word counts only on its own (end, not send). Empty, every turn past the threshold hands off.
endPhrases.default: 세션 종료, session 종료, 세션 end, end session
